turns.text: Hello, come in. How have you been since last time?
I made myself a cup of tea this morning and just stood by the window for a while.
What went through your mind then?
I finally went on a walk with Walter along the canal, an hour and a half.
How did that feel for you?
The train was late again this morning, so I almost did not make it on time today. That is how it was.
What happened next?
Joy asked how I am and I said fine again, though that is not true.
Mm-hm. Go on.
It is strange to sit here and say all of this out loud, but it does help a little. That is how it was.
What went through your mind then?
All of Denise's clothes are still in the wardrobe and I cannot bring myself to touch them.
I see. Can you say a bit more?
Some days are better than others, and I try to remind myself of that when things get heavy. I do not know, it is hard to explain.
Take your time.
It has been a grey week, and the weather does not help my mood much, to be honest.
Mm-hm. Go on.
I am still angry at the hospital, they missed the cancer for almost a year.
I see. Can you say a bit more?
I am not sure where to begin, there are so many things going round in my head at the moment. Yes, it was like that.
And how was that for you?
I had a long day yesterday and I was so tired in the evening that I just sat in front of the television.
Let us stop here for today.
Thank you, see you next week.
